articles.summary: Joins G Games in Platinum Launch Partnership for 99 Royale Mexico City, Mexico and London, United Kingdom, October 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) Codere Online (Nasdaq: CDRO / CDROW, the Company), a leading online gaming and sports betting operator in Spain and Latin America, today announced the launch of 99 Royale , a first-of-its-kind multiplayer slot experience developed by G Games. Codere Online will be one of the game's inaugural platinum launch partners globally. 99 Royale introduces a battle royale-style format to the slot category, enabling up to 99 players to compete simultaneously. Successful spins award power that can be used either to strengthen a player's position or to attack opponents, creating a dynamic experience that combines traditional slot mechanics with strategy and player-versus-player interaction. articles.title: Codere Online rolls out 99 Royale in Mexico in partnership with G Games
